## Executive Summary

The .ma ccTLD is currently served by 8 authoritative nameservers.

6 of 8 authoritative nameservers support IPv6 connectivity, resulting in an IPv6 enablement rate of 75.0%.

The authoritative DNS infrastructure is distributed across 6 distinct Autonomous Systems, improving resilience against network and routing failures.

According to Cloudflare Radar, 4.16% of DNS queries were successfully validated using DNSSEC.

DNSSEC validation rates vary across major networks, ranging from 0.57% to 12.87%.
